item.title: A Mountain Home teen suffered serious injuries in an accident in Salesville
item.description: A teen from Mountain Home suffered serious injuries in an accident on Highway 201 in Salesville. The Arkansas State Police reports that the 18-year-old girl was injured when she was ejected from the vehicle through the sunroof.

item.title: Wreaths Across America Event held in Mountain View
item.description: A Wreaths Across America event was held on Saturday at Mountain View, Missouri, at their Veterans Cemetery. It was held in conjunction with the national event that was observed at 11:00 A.M. all across our great nation.

item.title: A man from Paragould was arrested Tuesday in Randolph County.
item.description: 32-year-old Jackson Coffey was arrested on charges of possession of a schedule 1 or 2 controlled substance, possession of drug paraphernalia, resisting arrest, no insurance, and no seat belt. He was taken to the Randolph County jail.
